Actually, when I started the game I had at least 100 million more virtual chips than I had when I left the game.  
Beware - if the game “glitches” the response is,  everything works as it should but you can’t see it.  What you see is a glitch.   You think you lost chips but you won chips you just can’t see them.

What ever you do, do not add to the problem by buying chips from BF.  If you buy chips, the return will be very small, and not worth it.  You are better off putting real quarters into a real slot machine of a reputable gaming company.

They encourage you to keep betting with the oremise that you will earn crowns.  And if you don’t earn enough crowns, then you get kicked from your club.  It is all a trap.  

It is sad, because this used to be fun.  BF used to be a pretty good.   Actually they have a pretty good premise with lots of potential.   But, they got greedy and ruined it….  Especially in the last year or two, it changed for the worse.
